confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from one RBA search. The search result gave 0.6720 as the 18 Nov 2026 4pm rate and 0.6677 as an unconfirmed 19 Nov figure, so I used the confirmed 18 Nov rate. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of mylifeelsewhere.com, which averages user-submitted prices. It showed beer about $2.04-2.17, cappuccino about $1.67-2.06, and an inexpensive meal about $2.9-3.1. I raised these a little for tourist-area restaurant pricing. Mid-range meal for two, cocktail and wine are estimates. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, since imported wine and spirits are taxed heavily in Thailand. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge with no accommodation search. July is low season, so rates may be lower.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Thai beach resort towns such as Pattaya and Phetchaburi-area destinations, and with Bangkok. Hua Hin is a little cheaper than Phuket and a little more expensive than inland Thai cities.
